title: Sturdy star with thick textured finish
text: Sturdy star with thick textured finish. Moderately well constructed, I chose to try and save money since I planned to repaint anyway. Unfortunately the star was painted with a thick textured covering that I ended up repetitively having to use chemical stripper to remove. Not the simple sand, clean, and spray I had imagined. The flat textured paint also concealed dents which my glossy metallic spray paint accentuates.  So if I had left it, it would look fine but would not have suited my taste or decor.  Plan foiled. I hung my repainted dented star in a private view location and had to buy different stars.
